row.title: Five clocks read unmeasured because their only route needed a Cloudflare token
row.body: The transparency run had no usable CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN, so D1 clocks published 'unmeasured'. Clocks now fall back to the Worker's public /health; detector clock-measured (fm-loop-unmeasured) files Q-AUDIT whenever the published record holds an unmeasured clock.

title: Five clocks read unmeasured because their only route needed a Cloudflare token
